messages.content: Hey, I just wrapped up a meeting with Boss Zhang about the Shenzhen trip next month. We need to start getting things sorted.
Got it! Exciting stuff. What's the game plan for Shenzhen?

Well, the big news from today, July 7th, is that Boss Zhang decided I'll be the one leading the technical delegation for the trip! I'll need to make sure our trading system demos are absolutely flawless.
Huge congrats on leading the delegation! That's a massive win. Do you want me to help outline a prep schedule for the demos?

We'll do that later. First, we need to look at travel arrangements. Boss Zhang was complaining endlessly about how high the flight prices for the Shenzhen trip are right now. Oh, and when you do pull up flight options, keep in mind I prefer a window seat.
I'll keep an eye out for budget-friendly flights to keep Boss Zhang happy, and I'll definitely filter for that window seat. What about accommodations?

Just find something reasonable. Boss Zhang was actually joking about the hotel breakfast options for the Shenzhen trip, saying we'll probably just end up eating stale buns. Also, remind me to pack breathable clothes later—we were discussing the crazy humid weather expected down there during the trip.
Will do! I'll hunt for a hotel with decent breakfast reviews and add a packing reminder for the humidity. Let me know when you're ready to review those flight options.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-07, Boss Zhang decided that Linchen will lead the technical delegation for the Shenzhen trip next month.

messages.content: Hey, I just had dinner with Liwei and told her the news about Boss Zhang having me lead the technical delegation for the Shenzhen trip next month.
That's a huge milestone! How did she react to the news?
Well, she actually became noticeably anxious tonight. She realized that the Shenzhen trip overlaps with our anniversary month, and she's stressed I might be gone for the actual day.
Ah, that's completely understandable. Anniversary plans are important. Did you manage to reassure her about the dates?

I tried, but we kind of got sidetracked. She started asking what clothes I was planning on packing for the Shenzhen trip, and then we spent like twenty minutes debating whether I needed to buy a new suitcase.
Haha, a classic distraction. Though a sleek new suitcase wouldn't hurt if you're leading the team! Any other advice from her?
She did mention that her coworker went on a Shenzhen trip last year and had some tips. But honestly, I just kept talking about the local dim sum places I really want to visit while I'm down there.
You've got your priorities straight with the dim sum! Just make sure you lock down those exact travel dates soon so Liwei doesn't have to worry about the anniversary.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-07, Liwei became noticeably anxious because Linchen's Shenzhen trip overlaps with their anniversary month.

messages.content: Hey, apartment hunting is exhausting. I showed Liwei this funny meme today about apartment hunting in big cities—basically just a picture of a cardboard box renting for 5k a month. We really needed a laugh.
Haha, that sounds painfully accurate for the market right now. Did you guys actually go look at any places today?

Yeah, we saw a couple. The wall colors in one of them were incredibly ugly, like a weird neon green. Plus, Liwei was complaining non-stop about the high agency fees they want to charge us for these places.
Neon green walls and high fees? Yikes, definitely a pass. Did you at least figure out the logistics of moving to a new neighborhood?

A bit. We discussed how our commute routes might change after the apartment hunting is done. But honestly, because she's still anxious about my Shenzhen trip next month overlapping with our anniversary, I wanted to ground things. I seriously committed to Liwei today that we will finalize a strict budget for the apartment hunting by this weekend.
That's a really solid step. Nailing down the budget by this weekend should definitely help ease her mind, especially with the trip looming. How did she take it?
She seemed relieved. I just need to make sure I actually sit down and crunch the numbers before Saturday so I can keep my word.
I can help you crunch those numbers and pull some fintech magic whenever you're ready. Just give me a shout!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-08, Linchen seriously committed to Liwei that they will finalize a strict budget for the apartment hunting by this weekend.

messages.content: Hey, I just wrapped up my weekly phone call with Mom. We mostly talked about the apartment hunting. Honestly, I spent half the time complaining about how tiring the apartment hunting has been lately.
It really is exhausting, especially while juggling the trading system at work. How did she take it?
She meant well, but she immediately shared her opinions on feng shui regarding the apartment hunting. She specifically asked if the floor numbers were lucky for the units we toured.
Classic mom move! Did you manage to steer the conversation to something more practical?

I tried! I mentioned the grocery stores nearby the places we saw during the apartment hunting, just to focus on the convenience factor. But she really wants to make sure we don't pick a 'bad energy' place.
I'm sure she's just looking out for you and Liwei. Did you have to agree to any of her feng shui rules?
Not the rules exactly, but to give her peace of mind, I promised Mom I will call her for advice before signing any lease during the apartment hunting.
That sounds like a fair compromise. Keeping her in the loop before you and Liwei make it official should keep everyone happy.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-09, Linchen promised Mom he will call her for advice before signing any lease during the apartment hunting.

messages.content: Hey man, what a morning. Wanghao and I just finished debugging that production incident. We are both so dead tired right now after dealing with that mess.
Oof, sounds rough. Production crashes are the worst. Did you guys manage to figure out what actually broke?
Yeah, finally. Wanghao dug through the logs and concluded that the production incident was caused by a 500ms database timeout. It just cascaded and locked up the trading queue.
A 500ms timeout took down the system? That's brutal. How bad was the backlog?
Pretty bad. Wanghao ran the queries and noted that 15,000 transactions were delayed during the incident. We had to chug like three cups of coffee each just to stay focused while fixing the queue.
15,000 delayed transactions is no joke. Thank god for the caffeine! Is the team recovering okay?

Yeah, mostly just venting now. Wanghao was complaining about who got paged first for the incident, since the on-call schedule was messed up. He even joked about the alert channel name we used, saying we should rename it from 'sev-1-alerts' to 'impending-doom'.
Haha, 'impending-doom' sounds incredibly accurate for a fintech trading system. Glad you guys survived the fire! Try to take it easy for the rest of the day.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-10, Wanghao concluded that the production incident was caused by a 500ms database timeout.
On 2025-07-10, Wanghao noted that 15,000 transactions were delayed during the production incident.

messages.content: Man, what a day. We finally closed Jira ticket PROD-9912 for that production incident. You remember Wanghao found that 500ms database timeout yesterday? Well, I was looking at the exact server metrics today, and the CPU spiked to 98% on the primary node right as the delay hit.
Oof, 98% CPU and a 500ms timeout is a nasty combination. Glad you finally got that ticket closed, though. How is everyone holding up after all that chaos?

We're exhausted. Sister Chen was stressing out all morning, but she felt deeply relieved and completely relaxed once the production incident was finally marked resolved this afternoon. She even asked me where the standard post-mortem document template is so we can just get the paperwork over with.
I bet! It's always a huge weight off the shoulders when the fix is finally confirmed and deployed. Are you guys doing the review today, or putting it off?
Putting it off. We booked Meeting Room B for the production incident review on Monday morning. I just need to decompress now before the weekend starts.
Good call. You've definitely earned a break. Just relax tonight, maybe don't even look at a screen for a bit.
Yeah, definitely. Plus, I still need to finalize that strict apartment budget with Liwei this weekend like I promised, so I need to save some mental energy.
Right, the apartment hunt! Get some rest tonight so you're ready to tackle the budget with Liwei tomorrow. Have a great evening, Linchen!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-11, Sister Chen felt deeply relieved and relaxed once the production incident was finally marked resolved.

messages.content: Hey, finally done with work. Sister Chen is so relieved that production incident is resolved. Anyway, I just talked to Jiange about our weekend sports. He scheduled our badminton session for tomorrow, Saturday, at 3:00 PM.
Glad the incident is fully behind you! I'll note down the badminton session with Jiange for Saturday at 3:00 PM. Have you guys picked a specific court yet?

Yeah, we spent a while discussing the court floor material. We made sure to get one with proper wooden floors. Jiange mentioned his muscle soreness from last week, so he really needs a softer surface to play on.
Smart move. Wooden floors are definitely better for the joints and should help with his soreness. Anything else you need to prep for the game?

Not really, though Jiange talked endlessly about the racket brands we should use, comparing Yonex and Victor. Honestly, I'm just annoyed at the gear costs. I was complaining to him about the price of shuttlecocks for the session—it's getting ridiculous!
Tell me about it, sports gear inflation is real! I'll leave the high-end racket choices to him. Just make sure you both stretch before the game!
Will do. Getting this scheduled for 3 PM is perfect, because I still need to sit down with Liwei this weekend to finalize our apartment hunting budget like I promised.
Sounds like a well-balanced weekend. You get to blow off some steam at badminton, then tackle the apartment budget. Let me know if you need any help crunching those numbers later!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-11, Jiange scheduled the badminton session for Saturday at 3:00 PM.

messages.content: Hey, I just wrapped up the managerial review of the week with Boss Zhang. We went over the production incident from Thursday.
Hey Linchen! How did it go? I know Sister Chen was super relieved yesterday when it got resolved, so hopefully the review wasn't too painful.

It wasn't too bad, but Boss Zhang did comment on the length of the meeting. We were in there for over two hours. He also noted how many engineers attended the review—basically the entire backend team was packed into the room.
A two-hour post-mortem with the whole team sounds intense! Was the atmosphere super tense?

Not really. We actually chatted about a few jokes people made to break the ice at the beginning. Plus, I have to mention the snacks they provided during the meeting—the pastries were surprisingly good.
Pastries definitely make everything better. So, what's the plan going forward to avoid another 500ms database timeout nightmare?
That was the main takeaway. As a result of the production incident, Boss Zhang decided to implement a strict Friday code freeze policy. No more end-of-week deployments.
That's a solid call. A Friday code freeze should definitely save you all from weekend panics. Enjoy your badminton game with Jiange later!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-12, Boss Zhang decided to implement a strict Friday code freeze policy as a result of the production incident.

messages.content: Hey, I just caught up with Jiange about our workout schedule. Since I'm heading out for the Shenzhen trip next month, we needed to coordinate.
Makes sense! Did you guys figure out a plan for your workouts while you're traveling?
Yeah, Jiange agreed to pause our weekend workouts during the exact dates of the Shenzhen trip. He also asked me to pick up some souvenirs for him while I'm down there.
Got it, I'll keep your weekends clear during the trip. Are you planning to squeeze in any workouts on your own?

Maybe. I was just telling him about the gym facilities I might use at the hotel on the Shenzhen trip. But we also discussed potential flight delays for the Shenzhen trip, which could mess up my free time entirely.
Summer flights can definitely be unpredictable. Hopefully, you don't get stuck waiting around too long.
Let's hope! Jiange actually shared a funny story from his own past Shenzhen trip where he got stranded at the airport for half the day. Anyway, just wanted to make sure my calendar is updated.
Ouch, that sounds rough! I've updated your schedule so the weekend workouts with Jiange are officially paused during your trip dates. Let me know if you need help planning your packing list later!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-12, Jiange agreed to pause his weekend workouts with Linchen during the exact dates of the Shenzhen trip.

messages.content: Hey, just got back from the badminton session with Wanghao. Man, I have to complain about the gym temperature today, it was boiling in there. I was sweating buckets before we even started.
Sounds brutal! Did the heat slow you guys down on the court, or did you manage to push through?
We pushed through, but it was messy. Wanghao kept score, but he totally lost track. We actually ended up debating who served first in the second game for like five minutes.
Typical weekend sports drama. Did you guys just play, or did you end up talking shop between games like usual?
Oh, we definitely talked shop. While he was drinking this new zero-sugar Gatorade he brought, he dropped a massive bomb. He calculated that 85% of our microservices need refactoring.
Whoa, 85%? That's a massive amount of technical debt to tackle, especially with the new strict Friday code freeze Boss Zhang just put in place.
Yeah, the recent database timeout incident really exposed how fragile the architecture is. We're going to be swamped. Anyway, I need to go grab a shower and cool off.
Go cool off! Let me know if you want to brainstorm a refactoring plan later.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-13, Wanghao calculated that 85% of their microservices need refactoring, a metric he shared during the badminton session.
